facts.fact: Interministerial order of 20 July 2026, in force on signature, fixes authorisation fees under the Code du numérique, including US$30,000 for foreign and US$10,000 for local qualified trust services (electronic signature, certification); the document's acquisition note says the government suspended it on 1-3 August 2026.
